title: github-pr-explorer saved filters
description: saved-filters.json in the configuration folder (~/Library/Application Support/github-pr-explorer/config): the saved filters, in the order of their tabs. Everything, which matches every open pull request, is built in, always first, and not in this file. A folder with no file uses the defaults, Needs my review and Mine. A file that does not validate is not applied, and the app keeps using the last version that worked. The filter object is the one filter language: a layout rule or a search that needs a filter writes the same shape.

$schema.description: Optional. A link to this schema, for editors. The app ignores it.

formatVersion.description: The version of this file's format. This app reads version 1 only.

savedFilters.description: The saved filters, first after Everything to last. Ids must be different from each other.

id.description: Stays the same when the name changes, so the command line and MCP can name the filter: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit, such as blocked-in-api. "everything" is taken by the built-in filter.

name.description: The name on the tab, such as Needs my review.

filter.description: Which open pull requests the saved filter shows.

groupBy.description: How the list is grouped while this filter is chosen: one or two groupings, outer first, such as ["organization", "repository"]. Left out or empty: no grouping. A grouping the app does not know is treated as no grouping.

showsAsTab.description: True to show the filter as a tab above the list. False keeps it in the » menu and in Settings. Default: true.

filter.description: Sets of conditions. A pull request matches when any set matches. No sets match every pull request.

sets.description: Alternatives, joined by OR. Sets do not nest.

conditions.description: Conditions that must all match, joined by AND. A set with no conditions matches every pull request.

operator.description: is: the pull request has one of the values. isNot: it has none of them. Default: is.

values.description: Alternatives. status: draft, merging, blocked, changesRequested, running, failing, threads, waiting, behind, checking, ready, merged, closed. organization: a name such as acme. repository: owner/name such as acme/api. author: a login such as ada-park, or @me for the signed-in person. reviewState: approved, changesRequested, reviewRequired, noDecision, or waitingOnMe for a review asked of the signed-in person or one of their teams. draft: true or false. Organization, repository and author ignore case.
